truth_boundary: This contribution reorganizes reader truth and conceptual research memory. It does not prove a new Bandit/RL theorem, does not claim any COLT 2023 item is a core Bandit/RL question, does not claim the sparse-priming problem is permanently unresolved beyond the dated audit, does not import ASPBE or external quantum libraries into ABRL, and does not make conceptual setting-technique edges formal Lean dependencies.
